brief: 5 unhinged TikTok hooks that 10x'd our growth.

slots.title: BURN THE SCRIPT
slots.body: We stopped doing what the gurus told us. These five hooks felt completely unhinged, but they worked stupidly well. Here is the chaos.

slots.title: I'M NOT SORRY
slots.body: This hook stopped the scroll instantly. People got mad, then they watched till the end. Anger equals retention, apparently.

slots.title: THEY'RE BANNING THIS
slots.body: Nothing triggers curiosity like fake authority threats. We used this for a boring SaaS tip and it absolutely exploded. Controversy sells.

slots.title: WORST MISTAKE EVER
slots.body: Opening with failure hits different. Everyone loves a disaster story, especially when you flip it into a lesson. Trust the cringe.

slots.title: TELL ME I'M WRONG
slots.body: This one sparked 4,000 comments in two hours. We picked a hill to die on and let the algorithm do the rest. Chaos.

slots.title: COPY THIS EXACTLY
slots.body: Reverse psychology meets free value. We told people to steal our strategy and they saved it like crazy. Give to get.

slots.headline: GO GET UNHINGED
slots.body: Try one of these hooks today and watch your retention graph lose its mind. Tag us when it pops off.
